text: OpenAICompatibleClient (providers/openai_compatible.py) is shared by both LM Studio and OpenRouter since they speak the same protocol; the only differences are base_url, whether an api_key/auth header is required, and default model.

Tool-call responses in the OpenAI protocol must echo back tool_calls[i].id as tool_call_id on the following 'tool' role message -- Ollama's protocol doesn't require this, OpenAI's does. Missing this breaks multi-turn tool calling silently on OpenRouter/LM Studio.

gateway.py's build_llm(config) is the only place that should ever choose a provider class -- everything downstream (RepromptLoop, server.py, cli.py) depends only on the shared chat()/run_with_tools() interface, never imports a specific provider directly.
